item.title: Nowruz – Persian New Year Celebrated 20 Mar
item.description: Nowruz was celebrated on 20 March, marking the Persian New Year and the arrival of spring. It is observed by an estimated 300 million people worldwide.

item.title: Transgender Day of Visibility – Tue 31 Mar
item.description: Transgender Day of Visibility is Tuesday 31 March — a day dedicated to recognising the resilience and accomplishments of the transgender community.

item.title: World Autism Awareness Day – Thu 2 Apr
item.description: World Autism Awareness Day is Thursday 2 April. The 2026 theme is "Autism and Humanity — Every Life Has Value".

item.title: Theravada New Year – 2 to 5 Apr
item.description: The Buddhist Theravada New Year is celebrated from the first full moon in April (2–5 April) in countries including Thailand, Sri Lanka, Cambodia and Lao.

item.title: Good Friday & Easter – 3 to 5 Apr
item.description: Good Friday is 3 April with Easter Sunday following on. Easter celebrates the resurrection of Jesus Christ and is intertwined with Passover traditions.
